verdict.rationale: Jitsu can be fully self-hosted on your own Kubernetes/infrastructure (jitsu-docs-14, jitsu-docs-41, confirmed self-hostable in jitsu-probe-rt-2), which lets a user choose exactly where data is stored, and it offers DPA/SCC for compliance (jitsu-docs-44). However there's no documented region-selection feature for the hosted/cloud offering itself (e.g., 'choose EU vs US region' toggle) — self-hosting is the only mechanism for residency control. Missing for 10: explicit hosted-cloud region/residency picker, documentation of where hosted Jitsu Cloud data lives by default, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees beyond self-hosting.
